rawResults.Snippet: The HLK for NFC validates that the NFC driver implementation meets Microsoft specifications. Although the tests are able to be run manually, for automated, faster and more reliable testing for the HLK NFC test suite, we recommend that partners acquire the NFC Interoperability Test Tool (NITT). The NITT simulates Type 1, 2, 3, and 4 NFC forum tags.
